in_sanskrit.name: Along
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Being with, accompanying
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Along एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From the Old English word 'on længsian' meaning 'to remain near or be with'. The name Along signifies the presence of a companion, and the comfort that comes from being with someone.
